summary: PlacementCalendar is the calendar-based UI and workflow engine for managing Placement Requests in HSPnet. It enables users to search, filter, review, update, and link Placement Requests (PRs) and Placement Request Destinations (PRDs) according to various criteria, and visually track placements across configurable time units (term, month, week, year) with status, shift, and invoicing filters. Key features include bulk actions, calendar navigation, amendments and cloning, agency/site/service/destination filtering, advanced scheduling, invoice status management, linking/unlinking PRDs, and rich validation to ensure integrity of actions.
purpose: To provide a calendar-based interface for Placement Coordinators (PCs) and Receiving Coordinators (RCs) to efficiently review, manage, update, and report on Placement Requests (PRs) and Placement Request Destinations (PRDs) across various organizational, programmatic, and time-based criteria.

workflows.name: Placement Request Calendar Management
steps: User (PC/RC) loads calendar UI and initializes session and filters.
Select calendar view mode (Term, Month, Week, Year); navigation via Prev/Next controls updates displayed date range and triggers data refresh.
Apply filters: Placing/Receiving Agency, Department, Program, Course, Cohort, Site, Service, Destination, Type, UserStatus, Discipline, InvoiceStatus, PositionNumber.
Display Placement Requests and PRDs in filtered calendar cells, showing status, shift, dates, and linkage.
Bulk select PRDs via checkboxes. UI supports Select All/None, batch actions.
Choose bulk action from dropdown: status update, linking, merging, scheduling reminders, emailing reports/correspondence.
On status change, enforce validation: reason required for certain statuses, notes required for 'Other', confirmation dialogs for high-impact actions.
Apply changes: update PRD/PR status, trigger emails, create print jobs, generate reports, link/unlink PRDs, and update invoicing statuses.
System updates session and displays validation/warning/error messages as needed.
Advanced scheduling, amendment management, clone/copy date between PRDs, drill-down for week/month/term/year views.
Handle exceptions (e.g., invalid transitions, missing reasons, destination inactive, siblings updated/canceled).

workflows.name: Placement Request Linking Workflow
steps: User marks PRDs for linking.
System accumulates marked PRDs in a tray.
User clicks 'Link Requests' to link all marked PRDs (only if at least 2 distinct PRDs are selected).
System validates, links PRDs, and updates tray/UI.
User can unlink PRDs via UI controls.

workflows.name: Placement Request Amendment Workflow
steps: User reviews PRDs and associated amendments (add/edit/delete).
System builds lists of amendment dates and adjusts calendar bar rendering, reflecting actual placement days versus base schedule.
User may clone, split, or update schedule via Advanced Schedule UI.

workflows.name: Invoice Status Management
steps: User selects Invoice Statuses and filters; can clear or validate invoice statuses.
System enforces required confirmation for clearing/validating invoices.
Bulk update of invoice statuses with robust feedback/validation.

business_rules: Calendar view modes (Term, Month, Week, Year) drive date range and UI rendering.
Bulk actions limited by role and access level.
Status changes require reasons for cancel; 'Other' reason requires notes.
Linking requires at least 2 distinct PRDs.
Merging allowed only for local/sysadmin users filtered to specific cohort/course.
Certain PR statuses (Sent, Redir, AccD, DecD, DecA, Canc, Reac) are eligible for cloning.
Amendments override base schedule for PRDs on specified dates.
Position filter only visible if UseStudentHRInformation = 1.
Invoice management only visible in invoicing mode (PR filter 7).
validations: Date fields require valid date formats; StartDate must be before EndDate.
Required fields (reason, notes) enforced via UI and server-side.
Checkbox selection required for certain actions.
Confirmation dialogs for merge, decline, cancel, accept on behalf, invoice clear/validate.
Cannot link requests unless more than one distinct PRD selected.
Print job operations check for proper status and printType.
calculations: Calendar bar rendering calculates start/end positions, shift translation, block separators, long-shift indicators (>8hr).
conditions: Show/hide columns based on filter specificity (service/destination).
Show/hide reply section or reason dropdown depending on status code.
Edit permissions depend on role, access level, session flags.
Invoicing mode disables screen unless user allowed to edit invoice status.
system_behavior: Session variables persisted for user filter state and action history.
UI controls (dropdowns, checkboxes, radio buttons, links) update view state and trigger postbacks.
Popups for glossary, calendar, help, confirmation, report generation.
Dynamic error/warning/message display to inform users of outcomes or required actions.
Drill-down navigation changes calendar view granularity and updates displayed PRDs.
Bulk operations update status, generate print jobs, send emails, link/unlink requests, and handle exceptions.
dependencies: PlacementCalendar depends on PlacementRequest, PlacementRequestDestination, Agencies, Sites, Services, Destinations, Courses, Cohorts, Departments, Programs, GoverningOrgs, UserSession, Amendments, InvoiceStatus codes, Correspondence templates, Resources for localization, Dropdown UI components, SessionConstants, Hashing for URL security.
exceptions: Invalid status transition causes error and does not update request.
Siblings canceled/updated trigger warnings and linked help.
Missing required reason or notes prompt error.
Destination or site inactive disables action and shows error.
No action selected (none checked) prompts warning.
Print job operations may fail if parameters invalid.
content_gaps: The detailed UI layout, specific field definitions, and full business logic for all dropdown options and advanced scheduling are partially described but may require additional system or code-level documentation for complete fidelity.
Resource localizations and all possible Codes and Statuses are referenced but not fully enumerated.
Some referenced entities (e.g., PlacementRequestDestination, Amendment, Correspondence) assume internal models not fully specified in these documents.
